jd:
As the global leader in high-speed connectivity, Ciena builds the critical infrastructure powering the AI era. We’re a technology company shaping the future of networking, guided by innovation, integrity, and collaboration. Through development opportunities, meaningful work, and flexibility, Ciena supports growth and well-being—on and off the job. Connect with a career that matters.
  
  
**The Opportunity:**
Work term of 4 months starting in January 2027.
  
  
The CAD team works with CAD engineers and RFIC designers to turn AI-assisted layout ideas into practical tools for engineering design. The work focuses on building and evaluating prototypes such as DRC-clean parameterized layout generators or surrogate models that predict layout results without a full verification run. The role emphasizes careful data preparation, evaluation against designer-created layouts, and delivery of code and written evaluation that the team can continue to use.
  
  
**How You Will Make An Impact**

* Prototype machine learning and optimization methods for placement, routing and layout synthesis of RFIC and analog blocks.
* Build layout generators, including parameterized cells (PCells), that follow geometry, topology and foundry design rules.
* Build surrogate models and design-space-exploration frameworks so designers can compare options without running every candidate through the full flow.
* Own the data pipeline end to end, including generating layout datasets, training models and measuring the results.
* Write well-tested software components in Python and C++.
* Test results on real design problems with RFIC designers and CAD engineers, and report clearly where AI helps and where it does not.

**The Must Haves**

* Education: Actively enrolled in a Master’s or PhD program in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, EDA/CAD, Applied Mathematics or a related field,
* A Python project you built, such as research code, a course project or an open-source contribution, that you can walk us through.
* Experience training and evaluating at least one model with PyTorch, TensorFlow or scikit-learn.
* Coursework or project experience with data structures, algorithms and object-oriented programming.
* Interest in applying AI and machine learning to engineering design automation.

**Nice To Haves**

* Experience with C++.
* Experience with Cadence Virtuoso, SKILL or PCell development.
* Coursework or project experience in analog/RF IC design or layout, including DRC and LVS.
* Experience with graph neural networks or reinforcement learning.
* Coursework or project experience in computational geometry.
* Development experience with Git and Linux.

**Pay Range**
: The pay range for this position is $25.50 - 43.00.
  
  
Pay ranges at Ciena are designed to accommodate variations in knowledge, skills, experience, market conditions, and locations, reflecting our diverse products, industries, and lines of business. Please note that the pay range information provided in this posting pertains specifically to the primary location, which is the top location listed in case multiple locations are available.
  
  
In addition to competitive compensation, Ciena offers students access to the Employee Assistance Program (EAP), company-paid holidays, paid sick leave, and vacation pay as required by applicable laws.
  
  
At Ciena, we are committed to building and fostering an environment in which our employees feel respected, valued, and heard. Ciena values the diversity of its workforce and respects its employees as individuals. We do not tolerate any form of discrimination.
  
  
Ciena is an Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability and protected veteran status.
  
  
If contacted in relation to a job opportunity, please advise Ciena of any accommodation measures you may require.
fit_why: Requires graduate enrollment in EE/CS and EDA layout expertise

At Bose Corporation, we believe sound is the most powerful force on earth — and for over 60 years, we have been a company built on innovation, excellence, and independence. Privately owned, fiercely customer-focused, and driven by our values, we continue to lead industries and transform lives through sound.  
    
 Today, Bose Corporation is entering an exciting new era. Across multiple global Business Units and Global Functions, we are shaping the future of audio technology, automotive, luxury, and premium experiences. We invite you to join us in this transformation.  

 Job Description 
 
 ABOUT BOSE CORPORATION 
 At Bose Corporation, we believe sound is the most powerful force on earth — and for over 60 years, we have been a company built on innovation, excellence, and independence. Privately owned, fiercely customer-focused, and driven by our values, we continue to lead industries and transform lives through sound. 
   
 Today, Bose Corporation is entering an exciting new era. Across multiple global Business Units and Global Functions, we are shaping the future of audio technology, automotive, luxury, and premium experiences. We invite you to join us in this transformation. 
  
 ABOUT THE CO-OP PROGRAM 

 Bose Corporation is seeking students to participate in our Co-op Program who share our belief that sound is power. During the six-month co-op, students will have the chance to apply classroom learning in a hands-on work environment. Co-op participants will network across the business to gain diverse perspectives within Bose Corporation. Additionally, co-ops will connect with other students and colleagues, building valuable professional relationships for the future.

 Fall Co-op: Candidates must be available to work full-time (40 hours per week) in a hybrid, in-office format from July 12 through December 17, 2027. No relocation assistance is available. 

 Being currently authorized to work in the U.S. is a precondition of employment for this position .

 THE ROLE 
 We're looking for a Co-op to join our research team and explore how AI agents can support engineers working on active sound management technologies.
 The role sits at the boundary between signal processing and software engineering. You don't need to be an active noise control expert on day one; you will learn the domain from senior engineers who build these tools. You should be a strong programmer who is comfortable reading engineering code and asking why it works.
 In this role, you will:
 
• Capture expert knowledge. Work with senior engineers to document engineering workflows: key decisions, heuristics, failure modes, and what a finished result looks like. 
• Modernize engineering tools. Refactor existing tools into modular functions with well-defined inputs and outputs. 
• Connect tools to AI agents. Make engineering functions available to LLM-based agents using Python and modern tool-calling interfaces. 
• Measure what works. Build an evaluation framework that compares agent results against expert-produced references. 
• Build in safeguards. Implement automated checks that keep agent outputs within engineering and safety limits. 
• Prototype and demonstrate. Build an agent-assisted workflow and demonstrate it on a real engineering use case. 
• Report and document. Present your results and document your work so the team can build on it after your term. 
 
• To excel in this role, candidates should possess the following: 
• Currently pursuing a PhD or MS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field 
• Strong Python: writing modular code, packaging functions, using git, and writing tests 
• Working knowledge of MATLAB, enough to read and refactor existing engineering scripts 
• Signal processing fundamentals: FFT, spectra, transfer functions, coherence, and digital filters 
• Hands-on experience calling an LLM API or building a simple agent or tool-using app, in a project, course, or internship 
• Clear written communication; the role involves documenting expert knowledge, not just code 
 Preferred Qualifications: 
 
• Coursework or projects in adaptive filtering, active noise control, or acoustics 
• Background in optimal filtering, multichannel systems, or control systems 
• Familiarity with Simulink 
• Experience with LLM agent frameworks, tool calling, or agent protocols such as MCP 
• Experience designing evaluations or test suites for ML or LLM systems 
• Experience integrating MATLAB and Python 
• Comfort with large measurement datasets (time series, .mat or HDF5 files) and with plotting results clearly 
• WHAT YOU WILL LEARN 
 
• How active noise cancellation systems are measured, designed, and optimized 
• How to turn expert engineering judgment into reliable, testable software 
• How to build and evaluate an LLM agent for a real engineering task where reliability matters 

At Bose, you're inspired to be and do your best and are rewarded for your unique talents! Our compensation is thoughtfully tailored to your skills, experience, education, and location, and goes beyond base salary. The hiring range for this position in the primary work location of Framingham, Massachusetts is: $40.00-$51.25 per hour.The hiring range for other Bose work locations may vary.

In addition to competitive base pay we offer rewards including bonus programs, comprehensive health and welfare benefits, a 401(k) plan, plus exclusive perks designed to support your wellbeing, and a generous employee discount where you can immerse yourself in our products and experiences. We are a proudly independent company—driven by purpose, guided by our values, and united by a belief in the power of sound. As the world leader in audio experiences, we’re creating what’s next—pushing boundaries and delivering transformative sound experiences for people everywhere. Join us and make your next career move a mic-drop. Let’s Make Waves. ‎

12 Month Contract 

 Co-Op, Development Operations AI & Automation Enablement 

 This is what you will do: 
 The AI Solutions & Development Operations Analyst Co-op supports the Development Operations Enterprise Optimization team in advancing digital transformation, AI-enabled ways of working, data analytics, automation, and operational excellence initiatives across Development Operations. 
 This role combines data analytics, AI solution development, business process improvement, and technology enablement. The successful candidate will work closely with business stakeholders to identify opportunities to improve efficiency, automate manual processes, develop AI-powered tools, and create reporting and insights that support decision-making across the organization. 
 The Co-op will gain hands-on experience building and applying AI and automation technologies and data analytics platforms to solve real business challenges while supporting company-wide priority areas. 

 Responsibilities 
 
• Design, develop, test, and maintain AI-powered tools and solutions that improve efficiency and user experience across Development Operations. 
• Apply Generative AI technologies, Microsoft Copilot, Power Platform, and other digital tools to automate workflows and business processes. 
• Develop and maintain Power BI dashboards, reports, and analytics solutions that provide actionable business insights. 
• Support the development of frameworks to improve data driven decision-making. 
• Partner with business stakeholders to identify opportunities for process optimization, automation, and AI adoption. 
• Build prototypes, proof-of-concepts, and minimum viable products (MVPs)  
• Perform data analysis, data quality assessments, and governance activities to improve reporting accuracy and reliability. 
• Develop business process maps, user guides, training materials, presentations, and documentation for new solutions. 
• Support company goals related to operational excellence, digital transformation, and future-of-work programs. 
• Conduct research and benchmarking on emerging AI technologies and recommend potential business applications. 
• Support change management, communications, and training activities related to the adoption of AI-enabled tools and solutions. 
 You will need to have: 
 
• Experience with data analytics and visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or similar platforms. 
• Experience using and building AI tools and technologies, including Generative AI applications. 
• Knowledge of data management fundamentals and FAIR data principles. 
• Advanced knowledge of Microsoft 365 applications and collaboration platforms. 
• Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills. 
• Ability to learn new technologies quickly and work in a fast-paced environment. 
• Strong communication, customer service, and collaboration skills. 
• High attention to detail and commitment to data quality. 
• Experience with project management and balancing competing priorities 
 We would prefer you to have: 
 
• Degree in computer science (or minor) - Must be enrolled and graduating close to the contract end date or after. 
• Experience with Microsoft Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI, Copilot Studio). 
• Experience developing automations, workflows, chatbots, or AI-powered solutions. 
• Experience with Python, JavaScript, C#, SQL, or similar programming languages. 
• Experience with prompt engineering and Generative AI solution design. 
• Experience with cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure. 
• Experience building prototypes and proof-of-concepts using low-code/no-code development tools. 
• Experience with vibe coding and AI-assisted software development, leveraging tools such as GitHub Copilot, Microsoft Copilot, Cursor, Windsurf, Claude Code, or similar technologies to rapidly prototype and build solutions. 
• Above average experience with Microsoft Office applications including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Visio, and Teams. 
• Knowledge of the pharmaceutical industry, drug development, and clinical trial operations 
• Experience pitching, presenting and translating complex ideas to a wide audience 
 What you’ll Learn: 
 As an Intern at Alexion Canada, AstraZeneca Rare Disease, you will have the opportunity to learn about various positions with Alexion as you work cross-functionally with different parts of our business. Our purpose for this position is to ensure you gain key foundational knowledge that will complement your education through interesting work while leveraging valuable networking opportunities to expand your learning. You will be invited to attend various learning events including Town Halls, Industry Spotlight sessions Science Matters presentations, employee engagement events as well as many others so you will be well-prepared and qualified for future positions with Alexion and AstraZeneca. 
 We have a strong track record in developing and coaching interns to be successful for future positions at Alexion and AstraZeneca. Join us and thrive in a place where the brightest and most curious minds come together to unlock the potential of what science can do! 

 What to Expect: 
 This role is a 12-month paid contract position, which starts in January 2027. Our position will be based in our Mississauga head office and allow for flexible working arrangements working both onsite (2-3 times per week) and virtually. 
 Annual base salary for this position ranges from $41,495.20 to $54,462.45. AstraZeneca is committed to providing fair and equitable compensation opportunities to all colleagues. At Bose Corporation, we believe sound is the most powerful force on earth — and for over 60 years, we have been a company built on innovation, excellence, and independence. Privately owned, fiercely customer-focused, and driven by our values, we continue to lead industries and transform lives through sound.  
    
 Today, Bose Corporation is entering an exciting new era. Across multiple global Business Units and Global Functions, we are shaping the future of audio technology, automotive, luxury, and premium experiences. We invite you to join us in this transformation.  

 Job Description 
 
 ABOUT BOSE 
 You know the moment. It’s the first notes of that song you love, the intro to your favorite movie, or simply the sound of someone you love saying “hello.” It’s in these moments that sound matters most.

 At Bose, we believe sound is the most powerful force on earth. And we’ve dedicated ourselves to improving it for nearly 60 years. Ever since our founder, Dr. Amar Bose, bought a stereo system and thought, “I can make this better,” we’ve been relentlessly pushing forward to the next best thing. 

 Innovation is more than what we do. It’s who we are — constantly learning and constantly curious. We never stop imagining what better sound sounds like. We’re music fanatics and audio engineers. We’re explorers and inventors and dreamers. And we’re passionate down to our bones about making whatever you’re listening to a little more magical.

 THE PROGRAM 
 We're looking for students to join our Co-Op Program who are obsessively curious about 'what's next'. You'll get hands on experience with our products and learn from the best of the best in the business. You will immerse yourself into Bose for 6 months and get the opportunity to grow the skills your learned in the classroom with hands on work experience. By the time you end your time with us, you will have been given the opportunity to truly make a real impact in the future of Bose and your career!

 Opportunities don't stop at your day-to-day work. While you're getting an in depth look at your area of expertise, we'll expose you to other areas of the company. Our Co-Ops are given the opportunity to connect with senior leadership across the business to understand different perspectives at Bose. You'll network with other Co-Ops and colleagues to grow your network for the future! 

 TIME FRAME - January 11, 2027- June 25, 2027 

 THE ROLE 
The Bose Data Engineering team is responsible for design, development and enhancement of Bose Data Platforms (Analytics & Customer Data Platforms) in leading and supporting Advanced Analytics. This team is highly impactful and a key enabler of Bose Digital journey by playing a central role in the Data driven transformation.
 
What you will be working on?
 As a junior Data Engineer, you will work closely with internal customers to build and design data pipelines, spanning from data acquisition, deployment and monitoring. Being part of an agile delivery team, you will design, develop, deploy, and support data pipelines, applying best practices and implementing necessary integrations with our Data Platform ecosystem. This role requires a passion for operations, AWS Serverless solutions, Python, SQL coding & learning new technologies or programming languages.
 Under the supervision of a Senior Data Engineer, some of your responsibilities will include: 
 · Continuing the full life cycle management of data pipelines: designing, developing, and providing production support for data pipelines that support customer experiences on connected devices, web applications, and mobile applications. 
 · Staying up to date on relevant technologies, participating in user groups, understanding trends, and identifying opportunities to ensure the adoption of the best techniques and tools. For instance, we are currently utilizing Snowflake, databricks, and AWS Serverless technologies. 
 · Collaborating with AWS Cloud Architects to optimize and evaluate scalable, serverless solutions, becoming the Subject Matter Expert (SME) for AWS solutions. 
 · Working in multi-functional agile teams to continuously experiment, iterate, and deliver on new data product objectives. 

At Bose, you're inspired to be and do your best and are rewarded for your unique talents! Our compensation is thoughtfully tailored to your skills, experience, education, and location, and goes beyond base salary. The hiring range for this position in the primary work location of Framingham, Massachusetts is: $21.15-$29.09 per hour.The hiring range for other Bose work locations may vary.

In addition to competitive base pay we offer rewards including bonus programs, comprehensive health and welfare benefits, a 401(k) plan, plus exclusive perks designed to support your wellbeing, and a generous employee discount where you can immerse yourself in our products and experiences. As the world leader in audio experiences, we’re creating what’s next—pushing boundaries and delivering transformative sound experiences for people everywhere.  Company Description:  
 
 McDonald’s is proud to be one of the most recognized brands in the world, with restaurants in over 100 countries that serve 70 million customers daily. As the global leader in the foodservice industry, our legacy of innovation and hard work continues to drive us. 
 
 From drive-thru updates to delivery to mobile order and pay, we are innovating quickly and growing. Joining McDonald's means thinking big and preparing for a career that can have influence around the world. 
 
 At McDonald’s, we see every day as a chance to create a positive impact. We lead through our values centered on inclusivity, service, integrity, community, and family. From the support of Ronald McDonald House to our Youth Opportunity project and sustainability initiatives, our values keep us dedicated to using our scale for good: good for our customers, people, industry, and the planet. We also offer outstanding benefits including a sabbatical program, tuition assistance, and flexible work arrangements. 
 
 We are an equal opportunity employer committed to the diversity of our crew members, staff, operators, and suppliers. We promote an inclusive work environment that creates feel-good moments for everyone. We are interested in people who enhance our company culture: Does this role interest you? We encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every single requirement!
 Department Overview
 
 This opportunity is part of the Global Technology Infrastructure & Operations team (GTIO), where our mission is to deliver modern and relevant technology that supports the way McDonald’s works. We provide best-in-class foundational technology products and services including Global Networking, Cloud, Restaurant Infrastructure, End User Computing, and IT Service Management. It’s our goal to always provide an engaging, relevant, and simple experience for our customers. After we provide introductory training at our state-of-the-art Headquarters in Chicago, IL, you’ll join a product team within GTIO where you will focus on learning the capabilities and skills required to build a career in Infrastructure & Operations.

 Internship Details 

• This internship is based out of our global headquarters in Downtown Chicago. You MUST be willing to relocate to the Chicagoland area, if applicable, for the duration of the internship program.  

• We do offer a housing stipend.  

• You must be authorized to work in the U.S. and not require visa sponsorship for the internship and future employment.  

• Our interns work full time, Monday – Friday, during all 10 weeks of the internship (June 7, 2027 - August 13, 2027).  

• You will be eligible to participate in our Summer Hours program.  

• The internship pays $32/Hr  

 Duties

• Collaborate, design, and bring innovative products and services to market.  

• Design and build innovative technologies in a large, distributed computing environment, and help lead fundamental changes in the industry.  

•  Create solutions to run predictions on distributed systems with exposure to innovative technologies at incredible scale and speed.  

•  Build distributed storage, index, and query systems that are scalable, fault-tolerant, low cost, and easy to manage/use.  

• Design and code the right solutions starting with broadly defined problems.  

• Work in an agile environment to deliver high-quality software.  

• Play a pivotal role in development of product features from beginning to end.  

• Design, implement, test, deploy and maintain innovative software solutions to transform service performance, durability, cost, and security.  

• Work in a startup-like development environment, where you are always working on the most meaningful priorities.  

 Qualifications
 
 You are a strong candidate if you: 

• Are a Junior working toward your Bachelor's degree with a graduation date in Fall 2027 or Spring 2028  

• Pursuing a preferred major including: Computer Science, Computer Programming, CIS, Computer Engineering or other technology-related degree  

• Proficiency in leveraging AI to solve engineering and non-engineering problems 

• Proficiency in leveraging AI to solve engineering and non-engineering problems 

• Are involved in campus organizations, hold leadership positions, or have work experience in tech-related roles

About Tacit

We are an early-stage, deep tech startup based in San Francisco, developing innovative hardware that rethinks human-computer interaction. We are backed by General Catalyst, Khosla Ventures, and Greylock Partners, with a founding team from Stanford, BrainGate, Oculus, and Tesla. While we can’t reveal too much just yet, our team is tackling cutting-edge engineering challenges to bring revolutionary products to life.


ABOUT THE ROLE

As a data scientist intern, you be joining the ML / research team to develop new tools and techniques for data processing, data analysis, and improving our technology stack. You’ll be responsible for designing, running and analyzing experiments using our system, interpreting results to inform future data collection and hardware design, and improving our decoding algorithms. This role will feature hands-on work with our basic signals coming off custom hardware all the way up to studying performance scaling across large numbers of people.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Design, implement, and test algorithms for data feature extraction from bio-signals for use in machine learning models.

 - Rapid iteration on experiments for evaluating new hardware prototypes, data collection improvements, and to gain understanding of key aspects of our system.

 - Develop analytical tools for visualization and establish data quality metrics.

 - Work with hardware and electrical engineers to improve the overall sensing stack.

 - Collaborate with ML team on data augmentation, multimodal training, synthetic data experiments for improved generalization
   


REQUIREMENTS

 - Currently enrolled in (or recently graduated from) a PhD program in neuroscience, biomedical engineering, computer science, applied math, or related fields.

 - Effective communication and writing skills.

 - Ability to collaborate effectively across different teams and rapidly adapt to new fields.

 - Fluency in Python (and PyTorch is a plus).

 - Experience with dimensionality reduction techniques and time series data analysis.

 - Independent work ethic, flexibility, and resourcefulness.

 - Enjoy fast moving startup environment, excited to build independently.


STRONG CANDIDATES MAY HAVE

 - Familiarity with real-time human-machine interaction, ranging from automatic speech recognition to closed-loop neural interfaces.

 - Expertise with speech motor control, communication prostheses, and/or speech neuroscience.

 - Prior experience with consumer wearable devices.

 - Basic fundamentals in ML, ML infrastructure: experiment management tracking (e.g. Hydra, WandB) and AWS, Slurm.
   


COMPENSATION RANGE

$40-50/hour



DETAILS

 - Company size: 30-50 people

 - Duration: 12-24 weeks (Start spring/summer)

 - This position is full time, on-site in San Francisco
